title: Help Inez, second visit
why: Take 3 has the most life: she says yes too fast, the Fixer makes her hear the price, and she works out that the Fixer knows about Okafor.
changes: Changed Inez's line to "And his door empty. What happens to him?" She no longer implies the door is empty for only a minute.
Did not use the review's suggested line: at 13 words, it breaks the 12-word limit. Mine makes the same correction and names no duration for the empty door.
The last version showed beats only, so learned and opens are carried from take 3. Please check them against your saved version.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Look under my saucer, Inez. The rest of your loan's paid.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: My Bureau card. Yes, whatever it is, only put it away.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Hear it first. When I telephone, call Okafor over from his door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Why would he... you know about us. Who else knows?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It stays with us. He'd stand with you about a minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: And his door empty. What happens to him?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nothing, if this goes right. He never sees us.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'm with you. I see trouble on that square, I'll warn you.

learned: Inez is with us, and watching.
